what_it_demonstrates: Happy path: every requirement-pack item accepted at first attempt, clean provider results, low risk, no human escalation.

case_label: Case 2 - SME with unreadable director ID
what_it_demonstrates: Bad documents stopped before paid checks: unreadable director ID plus a missing UBO declaration, resubmission request issued, no provider calls commissioned.

case_label: Case 3 - corporate with registry address mismatch
what_it_demonstrates: Evidence-grounded exception: registration number matches, registered address does not; low-confidence OCR field corrected by an analyst before the comparison is relied on.
Structural opacity rather than an adverse finding: two-layer indirect ownership chain not supported by the registry, incomplete ownership chart, enhanced due diligence.

case_label: Case 5 - PEP match on UBO with moderate adverse media
what_it_demonstrates: Human-gated compliance acceleration: PEP match plus moderate adverse media on the majority owner, internal narrative prepared, generic customer message only.

case_label: Case 6 - possible sanctions match on a director
what_it_demonstrates: Critical stop: possible sanctions match on a director, no automated clearance, escalation to the MLRO queue, no customer disclosure of the reason.

case_label: Case 7 - serious adverse media on a director
what_it_demonstrates: Analyst escalation with an adverse-media summary, and the one recorded override: the model recommended enhanced due diligence, the reviewer escalated.
KYB intake only, routed to the future-phase branch: no risk assessment, screening, registry, identity, decision or evidence-pack rows.
Baseline for the problem cases: complete SME submission, clean results throughout, analyst approval recorded.

case_label: Control B - clean corporate on the complex-ownership path
what_it_demonstrates: Negative control for Case 4: same complex-corporate requirement pack, but a single-layer registry-supported 70 percent owner.

case_label: Case 11 - SME dissolved on the register
what_it_demonstrates: Eligibility failure rather than a risk finding: complete paperwork and clean screening, but the register returns dissolved, which is blocking and ends in a reject.

case_label: Case 12 - confirmed sanctions match on a UBO
what_it_demonstrates: The one unambiguous sanctions hit: critical severity, escalated to compliance, no automated clearance anywhere in the pipeline and no reason disclosed to the customer.

case_label: Case 13 - identity failure plus an unanswered media check
what_it_demonstrates: Insufficient evidence, not high risk: one identity check failed and one media provider did not answer, and a non-answer is never treated as a pass.
The quiet ending: one document requested, one reminder sent, no reply, case closed as withdrawn with no provider checks commissioned and no adverse inference recorded.
